requestedIntent: Owner request 2026-11-05 (Ram): human-like browser coverage per slice instead of only at phase/group close, after a Codex Astra consult (VERDICT: ADOPT-WITH-CHANGES). The tour is triggered by changed user behaviour and risk, bounded (one persona, one goal, one off-happy-path attempt, 1280/390, 5-10 minutes), its findings get dispositions before the verdict, and a small check binds the report to acceptance.

docs: CHANGELOG.md#Unreleased — Slice tours: human-like browser coverage per slice (2026-11-05)

limitations: tour.py checks the record's structure and bindings; it cannot prove that the exploration was genuine, that the persona was the affected one, or that the applicability judgement was right. The reviewer owns those.
Not enforced: nothing runs tour.py automatically. The coordinator runs it before acceptance and at closeout; a host may add it to its gate commands.

tour.py's tree check treats routing.docs_paths/exclude_paths and evidence_dir changes as no behaviour change; a host that renders markdown files as UI must narrow docs_paths, or a .md change passes without an impact note.
The trigger (changed user behaviour) is a reviewer judgement; route.py's ui_candidate is a path hint only and 'unknown' does not mean 'no UI impact'.
Pilot only: B2Press, next three qualifying slices, reviewed after seven days; no other host has a verified tour environment yet, and mft needs a simulator adapter.
The reviewer's model-family separation for tours is not checked (MODEL_CHOICE names gpt-6.1-terra; switching Codex models is not another family).
